Black Cherry Doubler's prizes make it a game that pays many small prizes and few large ones. Of the prize money still unclaimed, most is in wins under $100. The prize counts change every day, but this design does not.

Everything above about "Black Cherry Doubler" comes from the Virginia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.

"50X THE MONEY" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game built around small prizes that are won often. Expect the numbers on "50X THE MONEY" to move around for the first few weeks as early winners claim prizes. That is normal for a new game.
